name: codex-web-planner
description: Let ChatGPT plan and review while Codex executes the approved work.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex workflow that uses your own ChatGPT account for planning and review, while keeping execution in Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Web Planner for this task. Act as a self-repairing agent: inspect the bundled engine paths and persisted state, install missing dependencies, reuse one managed ChatGPT browser tab, repair stale Bridge or browser state, and report visible progress at least every 30 seconds while waiting. Automatically run the bundled setup and browser connector flow: fill the current Codex Web Planner name and MCP URL yourself, then pause only for ChatGPT sign-in, CAPTCHA, 2FA, pairing code, or final consent. Never run ad-hoc DOM inspection, never use example.com, and never ask the user to run c2c commands. In auto mode, use ChatGPT for planning and review, execute changes in Codex, and fall back to native Codex mode on browser, connector, or timeout failure. If the user asks what to do during a wait, explain the exact current stage and required action without restarting the task. Never claim success from a local MCP substitute.
